results.name: He Who Dares Collection
results.overview: These films follow the daring missions of a Counter-Terrorism Special Air Service (CT-SAS) team in London, led by Christopher Lowe. The team confronts ruthless terrorists with masterful skills and exhaustive training, often saving the country from disaster. Despite their success, they struggle with bureaucratic hindrances that threaten their effectiveness. The CT-SAS faces notorious terrorists linked to foreign extremist organizations, creating suspenseful and high-stakes scenarios.  The team includes distinct characters: "Admiral," the courageous leader with a strategic mind; "CaptainTEMP," the witty tech specialist; "Hillford," the strong combat specialist; "Angel," the sharp-eyed sniper with a mysterious background; and "Wise," the loyal explosives expert with unconventional methods. Their interplay of brawn and brains adds to the films' entertainment value.

results.name: Lonely Hearts
results.overview: A year after his wife leaves him; Jeff seeks solace in meeting women through lonely hearts dating. His attempts are emotionally unsuccessful and Jeff can't seem to move on. His denial manifests itself as a talking soft-toy pig that gives Jeff advice on his dating technique. But when Jeff meets a pretty girl in a sandwich shop; he realizes that he has promised to take the pig along on his next date.

results.name: Hegemony of Reality with Silent Fantasy
results.original_name: Hegemoni Realitas Dengan Fantasi Yang Sunyi
results.overview: In a quiet class, there are 12 students who do not do the assignment from Rama (teacher). Seeing that, Rama feels that he has lost his honor, so he gets angry and vents his anger by just keeping quiet. This situation makes them enter a world of isolation. Faced with a terrifying mute entity, which tries to control their minds and bodies. That's when the students' wild thoughts start to get out of control, with strange fantasies that they create in the midst of tension and silence. While Rama tries to control them. One by one they do everything they can to get out. But in the end, they are nothing in front of Rama.

results.name: Hepta Collection
results.overview: In the Hepta collection, the fates of lovers are intertwined across time, led by Dr. Shukri Mukhtar on a philosophical journey that reveals the seven secrets of the heart. From stories that begin with a spark of admiration to moments of heartbreak and survival, love manifests itself in different ways. With each experience, love is redefined not as a temporary state, but as a journey in which souls mature before hearts.
